I posted the draft bullets for June as a reply to your message in #coastal-team. I haven't sent anything to June.

The bullets cover:
- The rename of Covey & Lark Retail to Pellow Home Living on 16 Feb.
- The saved report that still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". This comes from Moss's 18 May digest.
- The clash with Pellucid Harbor Logistics, which also goes by "PHL".
- The related ticket, PD-4821.

I can't tell whether the report label was fixed after 18 May, because the digest doesn't say. I listed that as an open question. I also added an ask for June that you didn't request, to confirm the name and code for each account in the deal desk records. Cut it if you don't want it.
